newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Auckland confirm Super 12 domination.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Auckland confirm Super 12 domination.

text.p: Auckland completed an unbeaten rampage through the ranks of their Super 12 rivals with a 34-20 win against New South Wales in the final round of the regular season on Saturday.
But the Super 12 champions had to dig deep to overcome a fiercer than expected challenge from mid-table New South Wales.
Auckland secured victory by scoring 21 unanswered points in a determined second half display.
But their celebrations were dampened in the final minute when inspirational scrumhalf Ofisa Tonu'u went off with what appeared to be a painful shoulder injury.
